editorial:
Ever wondered what happens when a perfect life is actually a big lie? You get to see that here with Yuichi, a rich guy who seems to have it all. He has a great job running an adult video business and a lovely family that looks picture-perfect from the outside. But behind closed doors, he is totally bored with his marriage and spends his time cheating on his wife with just about anyone he can find. Everything changes when a woman from his childhood, Sanae, calls him out of the blue. This setup creates a tense, moody vibe where you just know something is about to go wrong.

What really works here is how the movie shows the gap between public image and private secrets. The acting feels very real, and the mystery builds up nicely as you realize Sanae isn't just calling to say hello. Some parts might feel a bit slow, but the payoff is worth it. If you like stories about messy relationships and hidden pasts, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The story ends with a shocking turn when you realize Sanae is not just an old friend, but someone seeking revenge. She lures Yuichi into a trap to punish him for his lies and cheating. The movie wraps up by showing that Yuichi cannot escape his past mistakes. He ends up losing the fake stability of his life as his secrets finally catch up to him in a brutal and unexpected way.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and stories about secret lives.
